title: EA SPORTS FC™ 27 | FUT Deep Dive
summary: Build your Club like never before in Football Ultimate Team™ with FUT Gallery, branching Evolutions, Single Player Live Events, and more.

sections.title: Overview
sections.summary: With EA SPORTS FC™ 27, you can immortalise your dream club with the all-new FUT™ Gallery, discover unique Holographic Player Items, shape Evolutions through branching Pathways, exchange with ease through streamlined SBCs, and more. Let’s jump into it.

sections.title: FUT Gallery
sections.summary: In EA SPORTS FC™ 27, your Player Items will have a lasting legacy in your Club through the new FUT Gallery. You can create records of Player Items passing through your Club, whether it’s the striker who led your FUT Champions Finals run or that one winger…

sections.title: SBCs
sections.summary: SBCs have been a core part of Football Ultimate Team™ for almost a decade. In FC 27, we’re introducing a new way to complete them and make earning rewards faster and more intuitive.

sections.title: Evolutions
sections.summary: Evolutions continue in EA SPORTS FC™ 27 with new updates designed to give you more choice and better planning tools. Two of the key additions are Pathways and Evolution Chain Preview.

sections.title: Campaigns & Live Content
sections.summary: The Campaign Hub is a new way to see what’s happening in Football Ultimate Team™. Football Ultimate Team™ Campaigns can feature new Objectives, SBCs, Evolutions, Gallery Sets, Live Events, and more.

sections.title: Item & Squad Upgrades
sections.summary: In EA SPORTS FC™ 27, we’re reshaping how Items improve throughout the season, with the goal of creating an even more balanced and satisfying squad progression journey and on-pitch experience. When we think about Item upgrades in FUT, we want them to feel…

sections.title: Rewards
subs: Immediate Rewards - End of Match Rewards
sections.summary: To support a steadier squad progression journey, we're changing how rewards are delivered so progress feels more immediate and flexible. Currently, much of the rewards in Ultimate Team are concentrated in weekly mode rewards, Objectives, and other…
